### How much does Replay cost?

Replay for Mac costs $10 USD once in the U.S., before tax. No subscription. One purchase activates two Macs. Paddle shows the price and tax for your country at checkout.

### Does a bot join my call?

No. Replay records Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams from your Mac. No bot joins as a participant, and there’s nothing to admit from the waiting room.

### How many Macs can I use?

Each purchase activates two Macs. An activated Mac works offline indefinitely. Contact support if you need to replace a Mac.

### Where do my recordings go? [...] ## What Replay does

Replay records Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams without adding a meeting bot. Choose a window to capture its video, the app’s audio and your microphone. Recording from the Zoom or Teams prompt captures that app’s windows on the call’s display. With Apple Intelligence, Replay writes editable meeting notes from the transcript. Recording, transcription, notes and search run on your Mac.

## Requirements and purchase

Version 0.2.14. Apple silicon · macOS 26 or later. Activate on two Macs using your purchase email. An activated Mac works offline indefinitely. Download the speech model for your language before using offline transcription. Current localized pricing and checkout.
